$comment: Derived from the code itself, in src/routes.js, src/App.jsx and src/pages/*.jsx. A section is one PageSection-level block (or a self-contained top-level component); its order is the render order on that page. implementedBy paths are relative to src/. The `*` catch-all (pages/ComingSoon.jsx), which stands in for links to unbuilt pages, is not counted as a route.

meta.source: Northstar marketing site (Vite + React clone of a live SaaS site's layout/motion, under a fictional brand with independently written copy), at http://localhost:5288

categories.SHELL: Site chrome rendered by the Layout or per-route options: header variants, announcement banner, footer variants.
categories.HERO: The first content block of a page, carrying the H1 and primary CTA.
categories.PROOF: Social proof and trust signals: logos, stats, testimonials, quotes, compliance badges.
categories.FEATURES: Blocks that explain the product: intros, split rows, grids, bentos, cards, composite homepage groups.
categories.CTA: Conversion bands placed mid-page or as the closing block.

shell.header-signin.description: A sticky 67px white header: wordmark, six click-open dropdown nav items, 'Contact sales', and an outline 'Sign in' button that opens the animated three-product menu. Below 1080px it collapses into a slide-in drawer.
shell.header-signin.scope: Routes with no `header` option in routes.js: the homepage, /plans and /enterprise.

shell.header-product.description: The same header shell with the Sign in menu replaced by 'Contact sales', a 'Log in' text link and a filled compact CTA whose label is set per route. An optional background colour also paints the drawer and main.
shell.header-product.scope: Product pages whose route has a `header: { cta }` option: /mail, /docs, /go and /agents.

shell.announcement-banner.description: A 56px lavender strip under the header holding one line of copy and a 'Learn more' link whose arrow nudges on hover.
shell.announcement-banner.scope: Homepage only; it is rendered inside pages/Home.jsx, not the Layout.

shell.footer-dark.description: A mulberry (#421d24) footer: brand title, four link columns (Products, Company, Legal with a cookie button, Connect with social icons) and a giant 5%-white wordmark.

shell.footer-light.description: The same footer layout in a light tone: #dedbd5 background, dark text, 80%-opacity links that underline on hover.

hero.product-carousel.description: A three-slide product switcher: a split-gradient grid with a nav list, a 10s autoplay progress bar, and 500ms cross-fades of copy and illustration. Below 1080px it becomes a single-slide layout with a next button.

hero.product-centered.description: A centred hero: a product lockup inside the H1, then a lede and a single filled CTA, then a full-width demo VideoSlot with a play/pause control.

hero.centered-over-art.description: A centred Intro-based hero (lockup, H1, filled and outline buttons) laid over full-bleed decorative chip artwork.

hero.split.description: A two-column hero with the H1, lede and buttons beside a large illustration. It stacks below 1080px.

hero.pricing-intro.description: A pricing-page title block: the H1 over a four-cell product glyph grid, on a beige-to-white gradient.

proof.logo-strip-rotating.description: A hairline-bordered grid of six customer wordmarks (six columns on desktop, 3×2 below 1080px). It fades in, then every 2s swaps one random cell to another logo from an 11-logo pool.

proof.logo-strip-static.description: The same logo grid, faded in once and never rotating, with variant-specific heading and colour (white on dark for enterprise).

proof.stat-band.description: A dark band with a single large statistic headline (highlighted span) over a watermark numeral illustration.

proof.video-showcase.description: A 16:9 demo VideoSlot with a pause button, followed by a proof line and a static six-logo grid, all over a pastel blurred background.

proof.testimonial-feature.description: One large testimonial quote on lavender (#e8e0ff) with attribution and an optional company logo and link.

proof.testimonial-trio.description: Three testimonials on dark blue (#0a476d), each with a round illustrated portrait, a serif quote and a company wordmark.

proof.quote-grid.description: An Intro heading followed by a two-column grid of customer quotes: a logo figure, the quote, and the name and role, with an optional avatar.

proof.quote-pair.description: An Intro heading followed by two testimonials laid out with TwoColumn rather than QuoteGrid. It is visually close to proof.quote-grid but built separately.

proof.compliance-badges.description: Two six-cell grids of invented compliance-style seal badges, followed by a link.

features.home-agent-group.description: The homepage's Agent product group: a centred intro, a wide media aside, two side-by-side asides, then five tabs of three feature cards each.

features.home-inbox-bento.description: The homepage's Inbox product intro with a three-card bento (one large card, two stacked).

features.home-pages-group.description: The homepage's Pages product group: an intro, a wide media card and two media cards.

features.home-enterprise-block.description: A dark (#281647) two-column enterprise teaser with copy and buttons beside a console illustration.

features.section-intro.description: A standalone heading block (H2, optional body, optional lockup, optional CTAs) that opens a group. Used on its own as a PageSection.

features.chapter-intro.description: A left-aligned chapter opener: a monospace '0N / 05 · LABEL' eyebrow, an H2 and a lede, on dashed side rails with a dashed top line.

features.split-feature.description: A single two-column row of a heading and body (optional subtitle and link) beside an illustration, with the media on either side.

features.split-feature-rows.description: A run of consecutive split-feature rows, each its own PageSection, alternating which side the media sits on.
features.split-feature-rows.scope: Two routes: /mail (two runs of five) and /enterprise (one run of four).

features.sticky-feature-rows.description: A run of rows where the text sits pinned mid-viewport beside a looping VideoSlot, fading in and out over 200px of scroll at 640px and above. On mobile they are plain stacked rows.

features.chapter-split.description: The chapter 05 trust block: the chapter eyebrow/H2/lede stack beside a single illustration.

features.icon-grid.description: A grid of icon tiles, each with a title, body and optional link. It comes in 2, 3, 4 and 6 column layouts, plus a centred variant.

features.card-grid.description: A grid of image cards with a caption or a title, detail and link.

features.helper-cards.description: Rows of agent/helper cards with an icon tile, a title and body (bordered with a tinted top band on /go, white rounded on /agents), optionally followed by an 'all agents' button.

features.bento.description: A 7/5-column bento: one large card beside two stacked cards, each with copy and an illustration.

features.aside-row.description: A wide aside card followed by two side-by-side aside cards, each with the heading first and small body text below.

features.connectors-strip.description: A static strip of invented app glyphs illustrating integrations: one row at 640px and up, two rows below.

pricing.plan-cards.description: Four plan cards (name, price, description, CTA, feature list). The third is highlighted with a 'Top choice' tab, a lavender background and a large elevation, followed by a 'compare plans' button at 1080px and up. On mobile the order is highlighted, Pro tier, Enterprise tier, Free.

pricing.plan-comparison.description: Feature comparison at 1080px and up: five accordion groups of fourteen section tables and 115 rows, holding check, text or empty cells, with Beta tags and info tooltips. The highlighted plan's column is shaded.

pricing.floating-plan-header.description: A fixed bar of plan names and CTAs that slides in over the site header (0.3s) while the comparison table is in view.

support.faq.description: A centred FAQ title and a list of accordion items with 0.2s height/opacity transitions and a rotating caret. It can be set so only one item opens at a time.

cta.cta-band.description: A mid-page conversion band: a heading and a button, split or centred, on a tinted background, with optional background art.

cta.cta-final.description: The closing conversion band directly above the footer: a heading and one or two buttons, stacked or split, usually the same mulberry as the footer.

cta.cta-final-home.description: The homepage's closing band: a heading and an outline button on #281647 over an animated gradient background illustration.
